row: At Solstice Physiotherapy, our physical therapists specialize in pelvic health. Our goals are to restore function and eliminate pain so that patients can restore their daily functionality. We treat a complex part of the body by integrating our knowledge of orthopedics, bladder, bowel, and sexual function to fully understand the entire person.
